contractual_basis: Fenwold Payments Master Services Agreement Schedule 4 clause 4.2
description: The Retry Orchestrator writes the full payment instrument identifier into the retry queue payload and into application debug logs. Debug logs are retained for 30 days and are readable by any engineer holding platform log access.
note: synthetic - fictional finding raised against a fictional system
remediation_progress: A logging change shipped on 2026-06-12 removes the identifier from newly written application logs. The retry queue payload is unchanged and 30 days of historical log entries were still in retention at the date of this register.
